shortDescription: Perform the OpenVPN Client Export action.

options.name: advancedoptions
options.description: Additional options to add to the OpenVPN client export configuration.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: bindmode
options.description: The port binding mode to use. If OpenVPN client binds to the default OpenVPN port (1194), two clients may not run concurrently.

options.name: blockoutsidedns
options.description: Block access to DNS servers except across OpenVPN while connected, forcing clients to use only VPN DNS servers.

options.name: certref
options.description: The reference ID of the certificate to use for this OpenVPN client export. This is only applicable for OpenVPN servers that require client certificates.

options.name: legacy
options.description: Do not include OpenVPN 2.5 and later settings in the client configuration.

options.name: p12encryption
options.description: The level of encryption to use when exporting a PKCS#12 archive. Encryption support varies by Operating System and program

options.name: pass
options.description: Password used to protect the certificate file contents.

options.name: pkcs11id
options.description: The object's ID on the PKCS#11 device.

options.name: pkcs11providers
options.description: The client local path to the PKCS#11 provider(s) (DLL, module)

options.name: proxyaddr
options.description: The IP address or hostname of the proxy server to use.

options.name: proxypass
options.description: The password to use to authenticate with the proxy server.

options.name: proxyport
options.description: The port where the proxy server is listening. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: proxyuser
options.description: The username to use to authenticate with the proxy server.

options.name: server
options.description: The VPN ID of the OpenVPN server this client export corresponds to.

options.name: silent
options.description: Create Windows installer for unattended deploy.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of OpenVPN client export to generate. This determines the format and content of the export file.

options.name: useaddr
options.description: The method to use for the OpenVPN server address listed in the config export.

options.name: useaddr_hostname
options.description: The hostname to use for the OpenVPN server address.

options.name: usepass
options.description: Use a password to protect the PKCS#12 file contents or key in Viscosity bundles.

options.name: usepkcs11
options.description: Use PKCS#11 storage device (cryptographic token, HSM, smart card) instead of local files.

options.name: useproxy
options.description: Use proxy to communicate with the OpenVPN server.

options.name: useproxypass
options.description: The type of authentication to use for the proxy server.

options.name: useproxytype
options.description: The proxy type to use.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the user this client export corresponds to. This is only applicable for OpenVPN servers that use the Local Database AND client certificates.

options.name: usetoken
options.description: Use Microsoft Certificate Storage instead of local files.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.

options.name: verifyservercn
options.description: Verify the server certificate Common Name (CN) when the client connects.
